title: Projektetage Drag Flow Pixel Offset Crash
description: Fix crash when dragging dispositions in projektetage: isFlowPixelOffsetTransform reads width on undefined measuredNatural because registry.getRect returns undefined not null.
summary:
Fixed projektetage disposition drag crash after drag threshold.

Root cause: `useLayoutEffect` cleared the slide disposition registry when a transform was active, but `flowPixelOffset` used `measuredNatural !== null`, which is true for `undefined`. `isFlowPixelOffsetTransform` then read `measured.width` and threw.

Fix: keep last measured rect in the registry during flow transforms; guard `isFlowPixelOffsetTransform` when measured is missing; simplify the `flowPixelOffset` check. Added test for undefined measured. All 40 renderer tests pass.
